raw_response:
I have farmed this land a long time, so I will start from what has worked and only move a little. On 57 mu, I cannot play games. If the crop misses, that loss is bigger than a few extra bags of fertilizer. Around here, wheat and maize are the main stomach crop, so I will keep most land in the wheat-maize cycle and leave a smaller piece for scallion to bring cash. I will put 50 mu into wheat and then the same 50 mu into summer maize after harvest, and I will keep 7 mu for scallion. I do what I have seen work on other people’s fields with well water: wheat needs the base fertilizer laid down and a topdress later, maize needs enough fertilizer early and one chasing fertilizer when it grows fast, and scallion needs more water and more spraying because if grass and disease get ahead, it is hard to pull back. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than watch the ears come short or the scallion stay thin. With only 2 people at home, I will keep the work simple, use rotary tillage on most land, water from the well when the crop really needs it, and not try fancy changes.
